summary: Describes private SIP extensions between proxies that support the PacketCable Distributed Call Signaling architecture. Telephone service providers need to exchange trusted information about customers and calls when operating across domains, and these extensions provide that.

eli5.summary: Cable phone companies pass calls to each other and need to share trusted facts about each caller. This note adds special message fields so they can do it safely.

questions: how do sip proxies exchange trusted caller information
